hebrewText: בְּ/אֵ֣ין חָ֭זוֹן יִפָּ֣רַֽע עָ֑ם וְ/שֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹרָ֣ה אַשְׁרֵֽ/הוּ

tokens.bdb: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanation: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanationEn: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle

tokens.bdb: a sight (mentally), i.e. a dream, revelation, or oracle
to loosen; by implication, to expose, dismiss; figuratively, absolve, begin
tokens.kjv: avenge, avoid, bare, go back, let, (make) naked, set at nought, perish, refuse, uncover.

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
tokens.kjv: beward, be circumspect, take heed (to self), keep(-er, self), mark, look narrowly, observe, preserve, regard, reserve, save (self), sure, (that lay) wait (for), watch(-man).

tokens.bdb: a precept or statute, especially the Decalogue or Pentateuch
happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!
tokens.ptLiteralWord: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection
tokens.enLiteralWord: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection
tokens.explanation: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection
tokens.explanationEn: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection
